name.en: Guangdong Government Outstanding International Student Scholarship at SZU — doctoral entrants, March 2027
name.zh: 深圳大学广东省政府来粤留学生奖学金（2027春博士新生）

summary.en: The provincial award is CNY 30,000 per year. It is an annual award amount; the notice does not assign it to tuition, accommodation or insurance components. Applicants must additionally download, complete and upload the Guangdong scholarship application form with the admission materials. The doctoral admission application window is 10 October–30 November 2026. The brochure does not publish a separate scholarship-only deadline or detailed award selection, quota and renewal timetable; this record therefore does not assign the admission deadline as a separate scholarship deadline. The admission fee is CNY 400 or USD 60, paid before submission and non-refundable. Dormitory charges are payable by students: Yuehai CNY 2,400–8,000 per person/semester, Lihu CNY 750 per person/semester, plus water/electricity. Mandatory university-designated insurance is CNY 800 per academic year; registration requires its purchase. These charges are not described as separately waived by the listed grant. A recruited international doctoral student’s supervisor provides at least CNY 12,000 per year for research subsidies or academic exchanges. This is designated research support, not an additional unrestricted living stipend or a promise that all listed grants can be combined. Basic university support may continue for the first extended year only; the brochure excludes the same treatment from the second extended year.
summary.zh: 省级奖学金标准为每年人民币30000元，简章未将该年度金额细分为学费、住宿或保险减免；申请者须额外下载、填写并上传广东省政府来粤留学生奖学金申请表。 博士入学申请窗口为2026年10月10日至11月30日。简章未单独公布奖学金申请截止日及详细评选、名额、续奖时间表；奖学金截止日保留为未公布。 入学申请费为人民币400元或60美元，提交前缴纳且不退。住宿由学生自行缴纳：粤海每人每学期2400–8000元、丽湖每人每学期750元，水电另计；指定团体综合保险每学年800元，未购买不予注册。所列奖项未另列上述费用减免承诺。 导师每年为所招收国际博士生提供不少于12000元科研补贴或学术交流津贴，该款有指定用途，不作为额外自由支配生活费或可叠加所有奖项的保证。延长学习的第一年可享学校基本奖助，之后的延长期不再享受上述待遇。

eligibility.en: For prospective international applicants to Shenzhen University doctoral programmes entering March 2027. These grants are listed in the new-admission brochure; admission does not guarantee an award, a particular tier or simultaneous receipt of multiple grants.
eligibility.zh: 面向申请深圳大学2027年3月入学博士项目的国际新生。新生简章列有这些可申请奖学金，但录取不保证获奖、具体等级或多项叠加。

eligibility.en: Applicants must be non-Chinese citizens with valid foreign passports, healthy and of good conduct, and comply with Chinese laws and university regulations. A master’s degree or above is required, normally under age 40; final-year applicants may submit an expected-graduation certificate but must obtain the master’s degree before enrollment.
eligibility.zh: 申请人须为持有效外国护照的非中国籍公民，身体健康、品行端正并遵守中国法律及学校规定；须具有硕士以上学位，年龄一般40周岁以下，应届生可先交预毕业证明，但须在入学前取得硕士学位。

eligibility.en: Chinese-taught doctoral programmes require valid HSK5 at least 180; English-taught programmes require valid English proficiency certification. Recognized native speakers of the corresponding language may be exempted. Obtain a recommendation from a prospective supervisor before applying.
eligibility.zh: 中文授课博士专业须有效HSK五级180分以上，英文授课须有效英语能力证明；母语为相应语言且经学校认定者可免交该语言证明。申请前须联系意向导师并取得推荐信。

eligibility.en: The doctoral admission application window is 10 October–30 November 2026. The brochure does not publish a separate scholarship-only deadline or detailed award selection, quota and renewal timetable; this record therefore does not assign the admission deadline as a separate scholarship deadline.
eligibility.zh: 博士入学申请窗口为2026年10月10日至11月30日。简章未单独公布奖学金申请截止日及详细评选、名额、续奖时间表；奖学金截止日保留为未公布。

eligibility.en: Upload master’s diploma/degree or expected-graduation proof, all postgraduate course transcripts, two professor/associate-professor recommendations with contacts, a Chinese/English statement of about 1,500 words, passport information page and photo, prospective-supervisor recommendation, language proof, a CV from primary school onward, physical-examination form, original non-criminal record plus Chinese translation, and a bank statement showing at least CNY 30,000 or equivalent in the applicant’s/legal guardian’s account.
eligibility.zh: 上传硕士毕业证及学位证或预毕业证明、硕士阶段全部成绩单、两封带联系方式的教授或副教授推荐信、约1500字中英文个人陈述、护照信息页及照片、意向导师推荐信、语言证明、从小学至今的履历、外国人体检报告、无犯罪记录原件及中文译件，以及本人或法定监护人账户不少于人民币30000元或等值金额的银行存款证明。

eligibility.en: The passport must expire after 30 June 2027, and its information cannot change before registration. Documents outside Chinese/English need notarized translations; incomplete applications are not accepted, materials are not returned, and SZU may request supplements.
eligibility.zh: 护照有效期须晚于2027年6月30日，入学报到前护照信息不可更改。非中英文材料须提供公证翻译件；材料不全不受理，材料不退还，学校可要求补件。

Dormitory charges are payable by students: Yuehai CNY 2,400–8,000 per person/semester, Lihu CNY 750 per person/semester, plus water/electricity. Mandatory university-designated insurance is CNY 800 per academic year; registration requires its purchase. These charges are not described as separately waived by the listed grant.
eligibility.zh: 入学申请费为人民币400元或60美元，提交前缴纳且不退。住宿由学生自行缴纳：粤海每人每学期2400–8000元、丽湖每人每学期750元，水电另计；指定团体综合保险每学年800元，未购买不予注册。所列奖项未另列上述费用减免承诺。

eligibility.en: A recruited international doctoral student’s supervisor provides at least CNY 12,000 per year for research subsidies or academic exchanges. This is designated research support, not an additional unrestricted living stipend or a promise that all listed grants can be combined. Basic university support may continue for the first extended year only; the brochure excludes the same treatment from the second extended year.
eligibility.zh: 导师每年为所招收国际博士生提供不少于12000元科研补贴或学术交流津贴，该款有指定用途，不作为额外自由支配生活费或可叠加所有奖项的保证。延长学习的第一年可享学校基本奖助，之后的延长期不再享受上述待遇。

name.en: Liyuan International Scholarship at SZU — doctoral entrants, March 2027
name.zh: 深圳大学荔园国际奖学金（2027春博士新生）

summary.en: Liyuan has three award tiers, all with a tuition waiver: first CNY 6,000/month (CNY 72,000/year), second CNY 5,000/month (CNY 60,000/year), third CNY 4,000/month (CNY 48,000/year), paid monthly. The assigned tier is not guaranteed. The brochure does not publish a separate award application form, quota, tier-selection method or renewal timetable; confirm these with SZU. No single monthly amount is assigned to this multi-tier award. The doctoral admission application window is 10 October–30 November 2026. The brochure does not publish a separate scholarship-only deadline or detailed award selection, quota and renewal timetable; this record therefore does not assign the admission deadline as a separate scholarship deadline. The admission fee is CNY 400 or USD 60, paid before submission and non-refundable. Dormitory charges are payable by students: Yuehai CNY 2,400–8,000 per person/semester, Lihu CNY 750 per person/semester, plus water/electricity. Mandatory university-designated insurance is CNY 800 per academic year; registration requires its purchase. These charges are not described as separately waived by the listed grant. A recruited international doctoral student’s supervisor provides at least CNY 12,000 per year for research subsidies or academic exchanges. This is designated research support, not an additional unrestricted living stipend or a promise that all listed grants can be combined. Basic university support may continue for the first extended year only; the brochure excludes the same treatment from the second extended year.
summary.zh: 荔园奖学金三档均免学费：一等每月6000元（每年72000元）、二等每月5000元（每年60000元）、三等每月4000元（每年48000元），按月发放。具体获奖等级不保证；简章未公布单独奖学金申请表、名额、分档评选及续奖时间表，须向学校确认。多档奖项不写成一个统一月金额。 博士入学申请窗口为2026年10月10日至11月30日。简章未单独公布奖学金申请截止日及详细评选、名额、续奖时间表；奖学金截止日保留为未公布。 入学申请费为人民币400元或60美元，提交前缴纳且不退。住宿由学生自行缴纳：粤海每人每学期2400–8000元、丽湖每人每学期750元，水电另计；指定团体综合保险每学年800元，未购买不予注册。所列奖项未另列上述费用减免承诺。 导师每年为所招收国际博士生提供不少于12000元科研补贴或学术交流津贴，该款有指定用途，不作为额外自由支配生活费或可叠加所有奖项的保证。延长学习的第一年可享学校基本奖助，之后的延长期不再享受上述待遇。

eligibility.en: For prospective international applicants to Shenzhen University doctoral programmes entering March 2027. These grants are listed in the new-admission brochure; admission does not guarantee an award, a particular tier or simultaneous receipt of multiple grants.
eligibility.zh: 面向申请深圳大学2027年3月入学博士项目的国际新生。新生简章列有这些可申请奖学金，但录取不保证获奖、具体等级或多项叠加。

eligibility.en: Applicants must be non-Chinese citizens with valid foreign passports, healthy and of good conduct, and comply with Chinese laws and university regulations. A master’s degree or above is required, normally under age 40; final-year applicants may submit an expected-graduation certificate but must obtain the master’s degree before enrollment.
eligibility.zh: 申请人须为持有效外国护照的非中国籍公民，身体健康、品行端正并遵守中国法律及学校规定；须具有硕士以上学位，年龄一般40周岁以下，应届生可先交预毕业证明，但须在入学前取得硕士学位。

eligibility.en: Chinese-taught doctoral programmes require valid HSK5 at least 180; English-taught programmes require valid English proficiency certification. Recognized native speakers of the corresponding language may be exempted. Obtain a recommendation from a prospective supervisor before applying.
eligibility.zh: 中文授课博士专业须有效HSK五级180分以上，英文授课须有效英语能力证明；母语为相应语言且经学校认定者可免交该语言证明。申请前须联系意向导师并取得推荐信。

eligibility.en: The doctoral admission application window is 10 October–30 November 2026. The brochure does not publish a separate scholarship-only deadline or detailed award selection, quota and renewal timetable; this record therefore does not assign the admission deadline as a separate scholarship deadline.
eligibility.zh: 博士入学申请窗口为2026年10月10日至11月30日。简章未单独公布奖学金申请截止日及详细评选、名额、续奖时间表；奖学金截止日保留为未公布。

eligibility.en: Upload master’s diploma/degree or expected-graduation proof, all postgraduate course transcripts, two professor/associate-professor recommendations with contacts, a Chinese/English statement of about 1,500 words, passport information page and photo, prospective-supervisor recommendation, language proof, a CV from primary school onward, physical-examination form, original non-criminal record plus Chinese translation, and a bank statement showing at least CNY 30,000 or equivalent in the applicant’s/legal guardian’s account.
eligibility.zh: 上传硕士毕业证及学位证或预毕业证明、硕士阶段全部成绩单、两封带联系方式的教授或副教授推荐信、约1500字中英文个人陈述、护照信息页及照片、意向导师推荐信、语言证明、从小学至今的履历、外国人体检报告、无犯罪记录原件及中文译件，以及本人或法定监护人账户不少于人民币30000元或等值金额的银行存款证明。

eligibility.en: The passport must expire after 30 June 2027, and its information cannot change before registration. Documents outside Chinese/English need notarized translations; incomplete applications are not accepted, materials are not returned, and SZU may request supplements.
eligibility.zh: 护照有效期须晚于2027年6月30日，入学报到前护照信息不可更改。非中英文材料须提供公证翻译件；材料不全不受理，材料不退还，学校可要求补件。
